reason: Shearjashub is the same son of Isaiah as Shear-jashub (Isaiah 7-8, 2 Nephi 17-18); keep the tipnr H7610 entity.
Carmel in Joshua 12:22 (Jokneam of Carmel) is the Mount Carmel range; same description as tipnr H3760H Carmel Mount.
Wilderness of Beer-sheba (Genesis 21) and Wilderness of Beersheba (1 Kings 19) are the same wilderness, spelling variant only.
Facsimile 1 and Facsimile No. 1 are the same Book of Abraham drawing of the altar of Elkenah.
Gerizim in John 4 is Mount Gerizim; keep the tipnr H1630 entity with coordinates.

Destruction of Jerusalem, Fall of Jerusalem to Babylon, and Fall of Jerusalem are all Nebuchadnezzar's conquest of Jerusalem under Zedekiah (587/586 BC); keep the entity with the most mentions and participants.
War against Benjamin at Gibeah (Hosea 9-10) is the same war of Judges 20-21 against Benjamin after the outrage at Gibeah.
Both are Moroni's victory over Zerahemnah in the eighteenth year of the judges (Alma 43-44); 10135 only covers back-references in Alma 45-46.
Battle at Cumorah (Mormon 8) and Battle of Cumorah (Mormon 6) are the same final Nephite battle.
Coronation of Joash (2 Kings 11) and Overthrow of Athaliah (2 Chronicles 23) are the same parallel-account coup by Jehoiada.
Crucifixion of Jesus and Crucifixion of Jesus Christ are the same event, split only by gospel.
Transfiguration (Luke 9) is the same event as Transfiguration of Jesus (Matthew 17, Mark 9); same place and participants.
Fall of Adam and Eve and Fall of Adam are the same event.
Exile of Jeconiah (Esther 2:6) is the same 597 BC deportation as Captivity of Jehoiachin (2 Kings 24); Jeconiah is Jehoiachin.
Christ's ministry among the Nephites (Nephi's vision, 1 Nephi 12) is the same event as Christ's visit to the Nephites at Bountiful.
Ascension of Jesus (Luke 24:50-51) is the same event as Ascension of Jesus Christ (Mark 16, Acts 1); Bethany lies on the Mount of Olives.
Provocation in the wilderness (Psalm 95:8) is the same provocation Jacob 1:7 quotes from that psalm.
Poor saints at Jerusalem (2 Corinthians 8-9) are the same Jerusalem believers receiving Paul's collection as Saints at Jerusalem (Romans 15:26 calls them the poor saints).
Parallel accounts (Matthew 14:35, Mark 6:54-56) of the same people of Gennesaret bringing their sick to Jesus.
The living creatures of Ezekiel 3:13 are the same four living creatures of Ezekiel 1. Ezekiel 10:15, 20, 22 says the cherubim are the living creatures he saw by the river Chebar.
Jeremiah 52:15 is the parallel account of the same captives Nebuzar-adan carried from Jerusalem (2 Kings 25:11, Jeremiah 39:9).
Ezekiel 47:2's outer gate looking eastward is the same outer east gate of Ezekiel's temple measured in Ezekiel 40.
Inner east gate (Ezekiel 40:23-34) and East gate of the inner court (Ezekiel 46) are the same gate of Ezekiel's temple.
All four are the wilderness strip dividing the land of Nephi from the land of Zarahemla (Omni, Mosiah 7-9, Alma 22, 26-28, 46-48).
The small neck of land in Alma 22:32 is the narrow neck between the land northward and southward (Alma 63:5, Ether 10:20).

Mountain of Judah (Joshua 20:7) is the hill country of Judah, the same as Mountains of Judah. Hill Country of Judah (Joshua 15, 21) and Hill country of Judaea (Luke 1) are the same Judean highlands as Mountains of Judah.
The temple of Babylon in Ezra 5:14 is the house of Nebuchadnezzar's god where he put the Jerusalem temple vessels (Daniel 1:2).
House of Ashtaroth (1 Chronicles 10:10, parallel of 1 Samuel 31:10) is the same Philistine temple where Saul's armour was put; keep tipnr H1045.
Book of Isaiah (Luke 3-4, book of Esaias) is the same record as Isaiah, the book of Isaiah's prophecies.
Vail of the tabernacle (Exodus 26-27) is the same curtain as Veil of the Tabernacle; spelling variant.
Jachin and Boaz (1 Chronicles 18:8) and Bronze pillars of Solomon's temple (Jeremiah 27:19) are the same pair of brass pillars as Brass pillars of the temple.

Isaiah 37:14 is the parallel account of the same letter Sennacherib sent Hezekiah (2 Kings 19:14). 2 Chronicles 32:17 is the parallel account of the same letters Sennacherib sent Hezekiah (2 Kings 19:14).
The Testimony before which Aaron laid up the manna (Exodus 16:34) is the Tablets of the Testimony. Tables of the covenant in the ark (2 Chronicles 5:10, Hebrews 9:4) are the Tablets of the Testimony.
John Whitmer's History (D&C 69) is the church history John Whitmer was appointed to keep (D&C 47).
The golden pot of manna in Hebrews 9:4 is the pot of manna Aaron laid up in Exodus 16:33-34.
Bronze bases (Jeremiah 27:19) are the same ten brass stands of Solomon's temple.
Book of the law of Moses is the same book as Book of the law, which already carries the alias book of the law of Moses.
Gold plate of the mitre (Exodus 28:36) is the holy crown, the gold plate engraved HOLINESS TO THE LORD (Exodus 29:6, 39:30).
Ezekiel 10:15-20 identifies the cherubim and their wheels with the living creatures and wheels seen by the Chebar in Ezekiel 1.
President of the Church presiding over the high council (D&C 102) is the office of President of the High Priesthood held by Joseph Smith.
Records hid by Ammaron (Mormon 4:23) are the sacred Nephite records Ammaron deposited in the hill Shim (Mormon 1-2).
Cherubims of Solomon's Temple (1 Kings 8, 2 Chronicles 3, 5) are the same two olive-wood cherubim of 1 Kings 6 in the most holy place.
D&C 103:21 names the servant of the nobleman as the same servant of the D&C 101 parable.
River of Egypt is described as the wadi on the southwest border of the promised land, the same feature as tipnr H5158M Brook of Egypt.
1 Nephi 12:16 identifies the river of filthy water as the river of water Lehi saw in his dream (1 Nephi 8).

Gilboa (H1533G) and Gilboa Mount (H1533H) are both the mountain where Saul and his sons died (2 Samuel 1:6 mount Gilboa, 1:21 mountains of Gilboa); TIPNR splits one mountain into two ids, so keep H1533G as an alias.
The wilderness of Lehi's afflictions (2 Nephi 3:1, 4:20) is the wilderness Lehi's family crossed from Jerusalem to Bountiful.

Wilderness of Judea (John 11:54) and Wilderness of Judah (Joshua 15:61, Judges 1:16, Psalm 63) are the same Judean desert as Wilderness of Judaea. Wilderness of the temptation (Luke 4:1) is the same wilderness of Matthew 4:1 and Mark 1:12-13 already tagged as Wilderness of Judaea; the Temptation of Jesus event links to both.
The mountain of the house in Micah 3:12 is the temple hill, Mount Moriah of 2 Chronicles 3:1; keep tipnr H4179 and carry over 15708's coordinates.
Rock Oreb (Judges 7:25) and Rock of Oreb (Isaiah 10:26) are the same rock where the Midianite prince Oreb was slain.
Most holy house (2 Chronicles 3-5) and Holy of Holies (Leviticus 16, Hebrews 9) are the same inner sanctuary as Most Holy Place; keep tipnr H6944H.
Rachel's sepulchre (1 Samuel 10:2) is the same tomb as Rachel's grave (Genesis 35).
Second Temple (Isaiah 44:28, Daniel 8-11) is the temple rebuilt after the exile, the same building as Temple of Zerubbabel.
2 Samuel 24 and 1 Chronicles 21 are parallel accounts of the same altar David built on Araunah's (Ornan's) threshing floor; 15391 is already located in 11185.
Gazathites (Joshua 13:3) and Gazites (Judges 16:2) are both the people of Gaza; spelling variant.
Brothers of Jesus (1 Corinthians 9:5, brethren of the Lord) are the same sons of Mary as Brethren of Jesus.
Sons of Korah of the Psalms are the Korahite Levite singers (2 Chronicles 20:19), the same clan as Korahites.
The book of this prophecy in Revelation 22:7-19 is the book of Revelation itself.
Five Books of Moses (1 Nephi 5:11) and Books of Moses (1 Nephi 19:23) are the same five books on the plates of brass.
D&C 77:6-7 interprets the book sealed with seven seals of Revelation 5, the same Sealed book.
Laws of the Persians and the Medes (Esther 1:19) and Law of the Medes and Persians (Daniel 6) are the same unalterable Persian law.
Brazen serpent and Brass serpent are the serpent of brass Moses raised in the wilderness, which 2 Kings 18:4 names Nehushtan; keep tipnr H5180.
Brazen altar of Solomon's temple (2 Chronicles 4:1) is the same brass altar of burnt offering as Brasen altar of Solomon's Temple.
Superscription on the cross (Mark 15:26, Luke 23:38) is the same inscription as Title on the cross (John 19:19).
Vessels of the temple (2 Kings 24-25) and Vessels of the temple at Jerusalem (Daniel 5) are the same temple vessels Nebuchadnezzar carried to Babylon.
Mosiah 28:13-20, Ether 3-4, and D&C 17:1 identify the interpreters given to the brother of Jared and kept by Mosiah and Alma as the Urim and Thummim.
Evangelical minister (D&C 107:39) is the office of patriarch, the same office as Patriarch (D&C 124).
Seed of Zoram (2 Nephi 1:31) are the descendants of Zoram the servant of Laban, the same group as Zoramites (Jacob 1:13).
Aaronites (1 Chronicles 12:27, 27:17) are the priestly descendants of Aaron, the same group as Sons of Aaron.
Azariah in Nehemiah 7:7 is the parallel-list name of Seraiah in Ezra 2:2, the leader who returned with Zerubbabel; tipnr H8304L already covers Ezra 2:2.
Children of Solomon's servants (Nehemiah 7:57, 11:3) is the parallel-list name of the same returning temple-servant class as Solomon's servants in Ezra 2:55.
Levi Hancock, president of the Seventy in D&C 124:138, is Levi W. Hancock of D&C 52:29.
Alma 8:20 and Amulek's own account in Alma 10:7 describe the same angel who sent Amulek to receive Alma.
Acts 7:26-28 retells Exodus 2:13-14; the Hebrew who wronged his neighbour and thrust Moses away is the same man.
Acts 7:26-27 retells Exodus 2:13; the Hebrew wronged by his neighbour is the same man struck by his fellow.
The prince of Ezekiel 48:21-22 who receives land beside the holy oblation is the same prince of Ezekiel 44-46 (45:7 gives him the same portion).
W. W. Phelps is William W. Phelps, the early Latter-day Saint printer in Missouri.
A. Sidney Gilbert (D&C 82:11) is Algernon Sidney Gilbert, the same agent to the church named Sidney Gilbert elsewhere in the D&C.
Temple lot at Independence (D&C 57:3, 58:57) is the same site appointed for the temple as Temple lot (D&C 84:3-4).
Temple at Jerusalem in Jesus' day (Matthew 12, D&C 45) is the same building as Temple of Herod.
Storehouse in Zion (D&C 101:96) is the Lord's storehouse in Independence kept by Sidney Gilbert (D&C 58).
Lake of fire in Revelation 19-21 is the same lake of fire and brimstone the Book of Mormon and D&C 76 describe.
American continent (Articles of Faith 10) is the same land as America, the continent of the Book of Mormon peoples.
Both are the high tower king Noah built near the temple in the city of Nephi (Mosiah 11:12, 19:5-6).

Temple in the city of Nephi (Mosiah 19:5) and Temple in Lehi-Nephi (Mosiah 7:17) are king Noah's ornamented temple in the same city (Mosiah 9:6-8 equates the city of Lehi-Nephi with the city of Nephi).
The narrow passage of Mormon 2:29 and 3:5 (also called the narrow pass) is the narrow pass by the land Desolation in Alma 50:34 and 52:9.
Alma's brethren on the Zoramite mission (Alma 35) are the same company Alma led to preach to the Zoramites (Alma 31-32).
